# EEPro archived index fixture

`freedomswing2019.html` is the complete 1,977-byte Apache directory index
retained during the authorized WP11 transport check on 2026-09-13 UTC.
Its original URL, archive capture, body digest, and receipt path are in
`freedomswing2019.json`. This copy requires no new request.

The source lists seven result files. Apache shortens the visible labels
for `jackandjillprelimssemis.html` and `strictlyswingfinals.html`; their
complete relative URLs remain in `href`. Tests parse this index in memory
only. No child watch is persisted and no score sheet is fetched.

This fixture verifies archived index extraction, not the historical round
formats, admission, identity linking, or event-year coverage.
